source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Attacks made by models in a unit the bearer leads get +1 to **Hit rolls** while that unit is under its **Starting Strength**, and +1 to **Wound rolls** too if it is also **Battle-shocked**. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.while: the bearer is leading a unit
effects.appliesTo: attacks by models in that unit

modifiers.if: the unit is below its Starting Strength
the unit is Battle-shocked and below its Starting Strength

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Unforgiven Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
